elements.label: Figure O.12
elements.description:
Two 100% stacked column charts titled 'Region' and 'Education' (y-axis: 'Share of the population', 0% to 100%). Categories on each panel: Extreme & moderate poor, Economically vulnerable, Population. No segment values are printed, so readings are approximate.

Panel 'Region' (bottom to top): Midlands & Northern Mountainous Areas (green), Red River Delta (blue), Central Highlands (yellow), Northern & Coastal Central Region (grey), Southeastern Area (orange), Mekong Delta (teal).
- Extreme & moderate poor: Midlands & Northern ~42%; Red River Delta ~3%; Central Highlands ~20%; Northern & Coastal Central ~20%; Southeastern ~2%; Mekong Delta ~13%.
- Economically vulnerable: Midlands & Northern ~24%; Red River Delta ~9%; Central Highlands ~9%; Northern & Coastal Central ~26%; Southeastern ~5%; Mekong Delta ~27%.
- Population: Midlands & Northern ~13%; Red River Delta ~25%; Central Highlands ~6%; Northern & Coastal Central ~21%; Southeastern ~18%; Mekong Delta ~17%.

Panel 'Education' (bottom to top): No education (teal), Primary (orange), Lower Secondary (grey), Upper secondary (yellow), Vocational (blue), Tertiary (green).
- Extreme & moderate poor: No education ~9%; Primary ~34%; Lower Secondary ~38%; Upper secondary ~14%; Vocational ~3%; Tertiary ~2%.
- Economically vulnerable: No education ~6%; Primary ~20%; Lower Secondary ~37%; Upper secondary ~22%; Vocational ~11%; Tertiary ~4%.
- Population: No education ~3%; Primary ~11%; Lower Secondary ~25%; Upper secondary ~22%; Vocational ~19%; Tertiary ~20%.

Pattern: the poor are concentrated in the Midlands & Northern Mountainous Areas and have low education, while the economically vulnerable are more spread across regions, especially the Mekong Delta, and have more upper-secondary and vocational education than the poor. Note printed under the figure: the extreme and moderate poor live below the LMIC poverty line ($3.20/day 2011PPP); the economically vulnerable live between the LMIC and UMIC poverty lines; household education is based on the maximum education level in the household. Source: World Bank staff calculation using VHLSS.
